bind_address.description: IP address the server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to allow connections from any network interface.

port.description: TCP port for incoming HTTP(S) connections.

base_url_path.description: Optional URL prefix (e.g., /bibledit) when deployed behind a reverse proxy.

data_directory.description: Absolute path to the directory where user projects, Bibles, and other persistent data are stored.

temp_directory.description: Absolute path to a temporary directory for transient files (e.g., uploads, conversions).

max_connections_per_session.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP connections allowed per user session.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to serve the application over HTTPS.

ssl_certificate_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (used only if ssl_enabled is true).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. One of: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

log_file.description: Absolute path to the main log file.

enable_modules.description: Enable loading of external modules (e.g., plugins for translation tools or language support).

modules.description: List of external module paths to load (only active if enable_modules is true). Each item defines a module location.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the module directory.

auth_backend.description: Authentication backend to use. Currently only 'sqlite' is supported.

auth_database.description: Path to the SQLite database file storing users, passwords, and permissions (used only if auth_backend is 'sqlite').

session_timeout.description: Session inactivity timeout in seconds (after which the user must re-authenticate).

cors_allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins for CORS (cross-origin requests). Avoid using '*' in production.

branding_title.description: Custom title displayed in the web UI (e.g., 'My Organization’s Bible Editor').

backup_enabled.description: Whether to automatically back up the data directory and database.

backup_interval_hours.description: Number of hours between automatic backups.

backup_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain each backup before deletion.

backup_directory.description: Absolute path to the directory where backups are stored.

database_backend.description: Database backend (currently only SQLite is supported).

database_file.description: Path to the main SQLite database file storing Bibles, projects, and documents.

debug_mode.description: Enable verbose debugging (logs extra details, disables caching). Only for development or troubleshooting.

smtp_enabled.description: Whether to enable SMTP-based email sending (e.g., for password resets).

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname (e.g., smtp.example.com). Required if smtp_enabled is true.

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (typically 587 for TLS or 465 for SSL).

smtp_use_tls.description: Whether to use TLS encryption for SMTP connections.

smtp_username.description: SMTP authentication username (if required by the server).

smtp_from_address.description: Email address used as the sender for outgoing emails (e.g., password reset links).
